engine.name: Tasty Chips ST-4
engine.description: Tasty Chips ST-4 hybrid synth tracker: every control change of its manual's MIDI commands, for each of its four tracks and for all of them at once.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/tastychips/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/tastychips/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the page's MIDI commands table, sent as its controller: a `chan` row on each track's channel (1 - 4), a `glob` row on channel 5, which the page calls all tracks, a `chan + glob` row on both. The page does not say on which channel a command that is only global is to be sent; it goes on channel 5. The page is a live one, saved on 2026-11-11; one fetched another day may read otherwise. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The page gives one controller to two rows: CC 11 (vca sustain, record sample). The first is laid out; the second is an action and is left out.
Left out, and named: pitch bend, pgm change, record sample (CC 11), midi beat clock, midi beat start, midi beat continue, midi beat stop.
The page gives vco mod CC 0, which MIDI otherwise reserves for bank select; it is laid out as printed.
